simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֹרֶן (H766) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֹרֶן (ʼôren) means the ash tree (from its toughness) First listed occurrence: Isa 44 14.

definitions.full: H766. oren I. אֹ֫רֶן noun [masculine] fir or cedar (Assyrian êrinu COT Gloss, Mishna plural ארנים ) Isa 44:14 (|| יַעַר עֲצֵי אַוֺן, תִּרְזָה, אֶרֶז, ).
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 765 (in the sense of strength );
